# ExpansionPanel

`ExpansionPanel` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `panel:open()`.

## Methods

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`open()`](open.md) | Open / close the expansion panel. | 1.5.0 |
| [`clear()`](clear.md) | Clear the expansion panel. | 1.5.4 |
| [`addLine()`](addLine.md) | Add a new line to the expansion panel. | 1.5.4 |
| [`event()`](event.md) | Set a handler called when an event (EVT_CLOSE / EVT_OPEN) is received. | 1.5.10 |
| [`rect()`](rect.md) | Get / Set the expansion panel rect. | 26.1.0 |
